review_scope: Existing lanes A and B; file import/export wording. This is proposed target-language text, not an application resource patch or a native speaker approval.

ch: formats22_ico_dimensions_error: prior English changed; rewrite to preserve the corresponding internal directory entry, not the external filesystem directory.
formats22_ico_decode_budget: decoding term still needs clarification.
formats22_ico_description: review phrase for compressed PNG and preserving the aspect ratio, centered in transparency.
save20_unsupported_tagged_colour: specialized profile conversion semantics remain unreviewed.

entries.source: ASCII art
entries.wording: Pinenta ASCII
entries.decision: Keep the established term pinenta and format name; label only, not a normal editable image.

entries.source: Width (characters)
entries.wording: Finedda' (simbulu siha)
entries.decision: Use the catalogue's own ASCII description (simbulu) so punctuation and symbols are not described only as letters.

entries.source: Previous page
entries.wording: I ma'pos na påhina
entries.decision: Previous page, not Back to the app.

entries.source: Selected page preview
entries.wording: Mostra i påhina ni ma'atyik
entries.decision: The chosen page itself is previewed.

entries.source: Page %1$d of %2$d · Loading preview…
entries.wording: Påhina %1$d gi %2$d · Mabababa i mostra…
entries.decision: Preserve selected page and total; this is opening a local preview, not a download.

entries.source: %1$s · %2$s\nNumber of pages: %3$d. Choose one page to edit as an image.
entries.wording: %1$s · %2$s\nNumirun påhina siha: %3$d. Atyik un påhina para un tulaika kumu pinenta.
entries.decision: User can edit one selected page as an image; don't imply editing all pages or producing a PDF.

entries.source: PDF must be a non-empty file no larger than 512 MiB.
entries.wording: Debi na i PDF un dokumentu ni guaha håfa gi halum-ña yan ti mås ki 512 MiB.
entries.decision: Use the positive non-empty condition; preserve the inclusive upper bound and MiB.

entries.source: PDF must contain between 1 and %1$d pages.
entries.wording: Debi na guaha 1 asta %1$d na påhina gi PDF.
entries.decision: Inclusive first and maximum pages; retain integer placeholder.

entries.source: PDF page selection is no longer valid. Choose a page from this document.
entries.wording: Ti balidu esta i påhina PDF ni ma'atyik. Atyik un påhina ginin esti na dokumentu.
entries.decision: Old selection became invalid; the user should choose from this document, not reopen another PDF.

entries.source: PDF page dimensions are invalid or too large to import.
entries.wording: Ti balidu pat mampus dångkulu i mineddong i påhina PDF para u mana'hålum.
entries.decision: Distinguish invalid geometry from geometry too large to import; reuse mineddong used in base UI.

entries.source: Icon size
entries.wording: Mineddong i ikonu
entries.decision: Same size noun as base UI; square icon context is supplied by the screen.

entries.source: Choose an icon size of 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 or 256 pixels.
entries.wording: Atyik 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 pat 256 pixels para i mineddong i ikonu.
entries.decision: Keep the seven discrete supported edges, not an arbitrary continuous range.

entries.source: GIF dimensions cannot exceed 65,535 pixels per side.
entries.wording: Ti siña lumampas 65,535 pixels kada banda i mineddong GIF.
entries.decision: Per side, not total pixel count or file bytes.

entries.source: The image exceeds the DIB file-size limit.
entries.wording: Mås dångkulu i dokumentu DIB para esti na pinenta ki i mineddong ni ma sedi.
entries.decision: The encoded DIB file would exceed the permitted size; not a pixel dimension or original upload size.

entries.source: The image exceeds the BMP file-size limit.
entries.wording: Mås dångkulu i dokumentu BMP para esti na pinenta ki i mineddong ni ma sedi.
entries.decision: Parallel to DIB while explicitly naming BMP.

entries.source: The Base64 text does not contain a supported image.
entries.wording: I tinige' Base64 tåya' pinenta ni masupopotta gi halum-ña.
entries.decision: Text may be valid Base64; the embedded image is absent or unsupported, not necessarily invalid Base64.

entries.source: There is not enough memory for this preview. Opening the page will offer smaller dimensions when possible.
entries.wording: Ti nahong i memoria para esti na mostra. An mababa i påhina, u maofrese mås dikiki' na mineddong siha an siña.
entries.decision: Preserve waiting until open, conditional offer of downsizing, and insufficient memory only for this preview.

entries.source: PDF rendering exceeds the available image memory budget.
entries.wording: I minostra i PDF mås ki i memoria ni siña mausa para i pinenta.
entries.decision: This is the PDF rendering budget, not a file-size limit.

entries.source: Lossless compression (Deflate)
entries.wording: Mana'dikiki' sin linaknos i infotmasion (Deflate)
entries.decision: Explain lossless in terms of retained information and preserve codec name.

entries.source: Saves one RGB page. Compression may reduce file size without changing pixels; turn it off for uncompressed TIFF.
entries.wording: Ha po'lu un påhina RGB. I minadikiki' siña ha na'dikiki' i dokumentu sin tinilaika gi pixels; desåtiba i minadikiki' para TIFF ni ti mana'dikiki'.
entries.decision: Single RGB page, potential (not guaranteed) smaller file, unchanged pixels, explicit instruction to turn compression off.

entries.source: Uncompressed 24-bit RGB; exact colours, larger files.
entries.wording: RGB ni 24-bit yan ti mana'dikiki'; eksåktu na kulot siha, mås dångkulu na dokumentu siha.
entries.decision: Preserve 24-bit RGB, no compression, and file size tradeoff.

entries.source: Export this version\'s source code…
entries.wording: Eksport i kodigu urihinåt para esti na bersion…
entries.decision: Use the catalogue's urihinåt pattern; exact version's source, not original version or image export.

entries.source: Stores a lossless PNG as Base64 text, beginning with data:image/png;base64,. Open this text file again to recover the image. Base64 is larger than the PNG it contains.
entries.wording: Ha po'lu un PNG ni tåya' malaknos na infotmasion kumu tinige' Base64. Tutuhun i tinige' ni data:image/png;base64,. Baba ta'lu esti na dokumentu tinige' para un na'ta'lu i pinenta. I Base64 mås dångkulu ki i PNG ni gaigi gi halum-ña.
entries.decision: Preserve exact data URI prefix (comma included), instructions to recover image, and size comparison. Review punctuation around the code sample.

entries.source: Saves an uncompressed 24-bit Windows DIB. Use BMP if the receiving app requires a BMP file header.
entries.wording: Ha po'lu un Windows DIB ni 24-bit yan ti mana'dikiki'. Usa BMP anggen i app ni risisibi i pinenta ha nisisita i header i dokumentu BMP.
entries.decision: Windows DIB is uncompressed; BMP only if the receiving app needs the BMP file header.

entries.source: PDF could not be read. The file may be damaged or use features unsupported by this Android version.
entries.wording: Ti siña mataitai i PDF. Siña madåñu i dokumentu pat ha usa kapasidåt siha ni ti masupopotta gi esti na bersion Android.
entries.decision: Replace malan with reading wording; qualify both possible causes instead of declaring corruption.

entries.source: PDF requires a password or uses unsupported encryption. Save an unprotected copy before importing it.
entries.wording: I PDF ha nisisita un password pat ha usa encryption ni ti masupopotta. Po'lu un kopia ni tåya' proteksion åntis di un na'hålum.
entries.decision: Password or unsupported encryption; save unprotected copy before import. Retain recognizable technical loanwords pending terminology review.

entries.source: Icon size
entries.wording: Cikconq dozsiengqbyau
entries.decision: Replace hung iq with current UI's size noun; use consistent icon term.

entries.source: Choose an icon size of 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 or 256 pixels.
entries.wording: Senj cikconq dozsiengqbyau: 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 rox 256 pixels.
entries.decision: Use Senj from the page chooser rather than switching verbs; preserve all seven discrete edges.

entries.source: GIF dimensions cannot exceed 65,535 pixels per side.
entries.wording: Cikconq GIF, moix bien mbouj ndaej gvaq 65,535 pixels.
entries.decision: State the bound on each side; not aggregate pixel count. Review moix bien for technical register.

entries.source: The image exceeds the BMP file-size limit.
entries.wording: Dajs iuj vwnzgen BMP gvaq hanh dingh.
entries.decision: Refer explicitly to the BMP file size, not image dimensions. Full wording needs Zhuang review; hanh dingh expresses the set limit.

entries.source: The image exceeds the DIB file-size limit.
entries.wording: Dajs iuj vwnzgen DIB gvaq hanh dingh.
entries.decision: Match the BMP limit wording and change only format ID.

entries.source: Base64 text
entries.wording: ⴰⴹⵕⵉⵙ Base64
entries.decision: Use the currently shipped Tifinagh spelling for text, not the earlier abbreviated spelling.

entries.source: Open page
entries.wording: ⵕⵥⵎ ⵜⴰⵙⵏⴰ
entries.decision: Same open-page action, not open whole document.

entries.source: Page %1$d of %2$d · %3$d × %4$d pixels
entries.wording: ⵜⴰⵙⵏⴰ %1$d ⵙⴳ %2$d · %3$d × %4$d ⵉⴷ ⴱⵉⴽⵙⵍ
entries.decision: Clarify selected page out of total using the from/of pattern; preserve width × height.

entries.source: Enter a page number from 1 to %1$d.
entries.wording: ⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⴰⵎⴹⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵙⵏⴰ ⵙⴳ 1 ⴰⵔ %1$d.
entries.decision: Enter a page number in the inclusive range; preserve placeholder type.

entries.source: Selected page preview
entries.wording: ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵖⵍⵉ ⵜⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵙⵏⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵙⵜⴰⵢⵏ
entries.decision: Matches the app's preview phrase; selected page only.

entries.source: Page %1$d of %2$d · Loading preview…
entries.wording: ⵜⴰⵙⵏⴰ %1$d ⵙⴳ %2$d · ⴰⵣⴷⴰⵎ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵖⵍⵉ ⵜⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓⵜ…
entries.decision: Use the same out-of-total wording as page dimensions and keep the in-progress preview state.

entries.source: Preview unavailable: %1$s
entries.wording: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⵊⵉⴷ ⵜⵎⵓⵖⵍⵉ ⵜⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓⵜ: %1$s
entries.decision: Name the preview using the exact established noun phrase; keep reason argument.

entries.source: PDF must contain between 1 and %1$d pages.
entries.wording: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵢⵓⵎⴰ PDF ⵙⴳ 1 ⴰⵔ %1$d ⵏ ⵜⵙⵏⵉⵡⵉⵏ.
entries.decision: Inclusive one through maximum, not an input request.

entries.source: PDF must be a non-empty file no larger than 512 MiB.
entries.wording: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⴳ PDF ⴰⴼⴰⵢⵍⵓ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵅⵡⴰⵏ، ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⵔⵉ 512 MiB.
entries.decision: Preserve both nonempty requirement and inclusive MiB cap.

entries.source: Choose an icon size of 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 or 256 pixels.
entries.wording: ⵙⵜⵉ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴽⵓⵏⵉⵜ: 16، 24، 32، 48، 64، 128 ⵏⵖ 256 ⵉⴷ ⴱⵉⴽⵙⵍ.
entries.decision: Keep all seven exact options and the shipped unit spelling.
